newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ s/adj visitor arrivals fall 1.0 pct, Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: NZ s/adj visitor arrivals fall 1.0 pct, Jan-Feb.

text.p: Overseas visitor arrivals to New Zealand totalled 166,280 in February, a rise of 3.0 percent over the February 1996 total, Statistics New Zealand (SNZ) said on Friday.

This compares with an 11 percent increase between February 1995 and February 1996. However, after adjustments for seasonal variations, the number of arrivals dropped by 1.0 percent between January and February this year. This follows a 7.0 percent drop between December 1996 and January 1997, SNZ said.

On an annual basis, overseas visitor numbers have shown a steady increase. In the year to February, overseas visitor arrivals totalled 1.54 million, up eight percent on the year to February, 1996, SNZ said.
